page.layout: One printed page, one column of running text, no marginal notes. Running head at top centre-right with page number at top right. Catchword and gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.l: XI. Amplius Opponens; Quia autem
resurrectio Christi ad vitam perpetuam
ac beatam & regnum est primus fructus
operis Dei in morte Christi consummati,
& testimonium evidentissimum justifica-
tionis in morte ipsius paratę, & ejus resu-
scitatio quasi nostrî, qui in ipsum
credimus, absolutio; simulque distributio dierum
mundi per hebdomadem, indè à dato
Manna (de quo certò constat) in mundo
est, & ejus miraculi (quod Deum crea-
torem omnium demonstrat) memoria
usu civili illius distributionis dierum con-
servari potest; non absque magnâ ratione
factum est, ut prima Sabbatorum, ἡ
ἀναστάσεως ἢ σωτηρίου ἡμῶν ἡμέρα. Euseb. libr.
5. 23. ἡ ἀναστασίμου, Ignat. ad Ma-
gnes. Clementi Rom.lib. 2. c. 58. dies
resurrectionis Dominica, Leoni 1. epist. 81. c. 1. dies Dominica à resurrectione Domini,
quasi dies à Domino insignitus, nomina-
tur. Quemadmodùm & mensa Domini
& cœna Domini, appellatur, in quâ ut
Apostoli, itâ nos quasi cum Domino epu-
lamur. Quâ analogiâ Veteres non tan-
tùm diem sed & locum, in quo fit con-
gregatio

page.notes: Greek passages are set in a mixed, partly damaged font; the Greek words after "ἡ ἀνα-" and "ἡ σωτῆρ" are uncertain and may contain errors. The line "Ignat. ad Magnes." and the Greek word "ἀναστασίμου" are partly obscured. Catchword "gregatio" and signature "R" are at the foot.
